method: Routes use OSRM from central Seattle to each previously reviewed campground coordinate. Public estimates round upward for towing, traffic, mountain passes, and unpaved or seasonal forest roads. Closure and end-of-season notes come from current operator material and do not convert a planning baseline into a claim that a route is presently open.

reviews.route_note: Planning baseline only. The entire Ohanapecosh developed area is closed to visitor access for the 2026 season; public estimate adds towing and traffic margin for future seasons.

WA 410 and White River Road route. White River Road and the campground reopened September 5, 2026; the Sunrise Road beyond the campground remains closed due to fire activity. Public estimate adds towing and traffic margin.
Fastest normal I-5, WA 530, and SR 20 route at review time; public estimate adds towing and traffic margin. Loop C closes September 14, 2026 and Loops A and B close September 27.
Fastest normal I-5, WA 530, and SR 20 route at review time; public estimate adds towing and traffic margin. Primitive camping continues after the operational season without water or trash service.

SR 20 route to Diablo Lake; public estimate adds towing and mountain-road margin. Vehicle campsites close September 14, 2026; only ten walk-in tent sites remain available outside the operational season.
SR 20 route to Diablo Lake; public estimate adds towing and mountain-road margin. Colonial Creek North closes for the season September 14, 2026.
US 2, Icicle Road, and Forest Road 7600 route; public estimate adds towing, pass traffic, and local-road margin. Check current seasonal campground and Icicle Road conditions.

All-road route through the Okanogan Highlands to County Road 4953 and Forest Road 32; public estimate adds towing, traffic, and remote-road margin. This corrects a prior estimate more than two hours below the measured route.

Long all-road route across eastern Washington to Sullivan Lake Road; public estimate adds towing, fuel-stop, traffic, and remote-road margin. Confirm seasonal opening and current Colville National Forest alerts.
Mountain and forest-road route to Forest Road 2329; public estimate adds towing, gravel-road, and seasonal-condition margin. Check Gifford Pinchot road and fire alerts before departure.
US 12 and Forest Road 21 route; public estimate adds towing and rough-gravel-road margin. Forest Road 21 can be washboarded, and seasonal or fire closures can change access.
I-90 and Forest Road 58 route; public estimate adds towing, pass traffic, and campground-road margin.
I-90, WA 903, and Salmon La Sac Road route; public estimate adds towing, traffic, and mountain-road margin.
I-90, I-82, WA 410, and Bumping Lake Road route; public estimate adds towing, pass, and remote-road margin. Check seasonal road and fire conditions.
Fastest normal route to US 12 near Packwood; public estimate adds towing and traffic margin. Check current campground and fire status before travel.
Remote Gifford Pinchot forest-road route to the Lewis River; public estimate adds towing, fuel-stop, rough-road, and seasonal-condition margin. Verify road and fire alerts before departure.
I-5, WA 20, Baker Lake Road, and campground access road route; public estimate adds towing, traffic, and local-road margin.
